name: google/gemini-3-pro-image
display_name: Google: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image)
description: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) is the Pro-tier image generation and editing model of Google's Gemini 3 line, using a reasoning core and producing images alongside text. Google positions it for professional work such as complex graphic design, high-fidelity product mockups and factual data visualizations that need accurate text rendering, with real-world grounding via Google Search and studio-quality visuals up to 4K. Pick Nano Banana 2 instead for faster, higher-volume generation.
